steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟活動頁，並下載 CUBE App。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the campaign page and download the CUBE app.

steps.zh-TW: 依 App 指示完成註冊或開戶流程。
steps.en: Follow the app's instructions to register or open an account.

steps.zh-TW: 在邀請碼欄位輸入 H21AU；若連結已自動帶入，請確認內容相符。
steps.en: Enter H21AU in the invite code field; if the link already filled it in, check that it matches.

intro.zh-TW: 國泰世華銀行的 CUBE App。點擊連結下載，並輸入邀請碼。
intro.en: Cathay United Bank's CUBE app. Download it from the link and enter the invite code.

description.zh-TW:
國泰世華 CUBE App 是國泰世華銀行的 App，可依指示完成註冊或開戶流程。本站的邀請連結會開啟活動頁並引導下載 App，連結已帶有邀請碼 H21AU，可能已自動帶入；若邀請碼欄位是空的，請自行輸入。

送出前請確認網址的網域屬於官方，並核對欄位中的邀請碼與本頁相同；也可以先複製本頁的邀請碼，等 App 要求輸入時再貼上。
description.en:
CUBE is a Cathay United Bank app that guides you through registration or account opening. The invite link on this page opens a campaign page and leads you to the app download. It already carries invite code H21AU, which may be filled in automatically; if the invite code field is empty, enter it yourself.

Before you submit anything, check that the address domain belongs to the bank and that the code in the field matches the one on this page. You can also copy the code here first and paste it when the app asks.
